name: Porgy & Bess
notes: listing HTML gives date/time/title/category; price needs one detail-page fetch per event (185 requests, ~30s). end/duration: site publishes no text duration; the .ics export has DTEND but it is always exactly DTSTART+2h00m for every event checked (matinees, brunches, late shows alike) - a CMS default, not real data, so end is deliberately left null rather than passed through.
